errors.text_span: 横轴按类别列出了 8 个模型，分别为：ChatGLM3-6b、ChatGLM3-6b-COT、GPT3.5-turbo、GPT3.5-turbo-COT、Llama2-7b、Llama2-7b-COT、QWen1.5-7b 和 QWen1.5-7b-COT
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the 8 models are listed on the horizontal axis. The horizontal axis actually shows the four evaluation metrics (Fluency, Coherence, Consistency, Relevance), while the 8 models are the series represented by the different colored bars within each group, as defined in the legend.

errors.text_span: 柱状图采用堆叠分组形式
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are stacked and grouped. The chart is a grouped bar chart; the bars are placed side-by-side within each category, not stacked on top of each other.

errors.text_span: 流畅度（Fluency）得分范围约为 8.9-9.4；连贯性（Coherence）得分范围约为 8.8-9.2；一致性（Consistency）得分范围约为 8.7-9.0；相关性（Relevance）得分范围约为 7.9-9.0
errors.evidence: Most of the reported score ranges are incorrect. For example, for Coherence, the actual range is approximately 8.3 to 9.2, not 8.8-9.2. For Consistency, the actual range is approximately 8.1 to 9.4, not 8.7-9.0. For Relevance, the actual range is approximately 8.1 to 9.3, not 7.9-9.0. The maximum for Fluency is also slightly overestimated at 9.4 when it is closer to 9.3.

errors.text_span: QWen1.5-7b-COT 在流畅度上的得分最高，接近 9.4
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The highest scores for Fluency belong to GPT3.5-turbo and GPT3.5-turbo-COT (the two orange bars), which are at approximately 9.3. The bar for QWen1.5-7b-COT (dark red) is lower, at about 9.2.

errors.text_span: 而 QWen1.5-7b 在相关性上的得分最低，约为 7.9
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The lowest score for Relevance belongs to ChatGLM3-6b (light blue bar) at approximately 8.1. The score for QWen1.5-7b (light red/pink bar) is higher, at about 8.3. The value 7.9 is also incorrect.
